description.value: Greek Island Pizza is a fast-food pizza outlet mapped in North Vancouver, BC. Beyond the OSM name and cuisine tags, no verified information about the actual business could be obtained, as the associated URL resolves to an unrelated Indonesian-language website. A touring cyclist would need to verify independently before relying on this listing.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website discovered for this OSM record (greek-island-pizza.com) is entirely in Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia), contains content about pizza restaurants in Surabaya, Indonesia, and includes suspicious categories ('Slot Gacor', 'Ibcbet Login') typical of domain-squatting or SEO spam sites. It bears no relation to a North Vancouver pizza business. The OSM record itself provides only the business name, a pizza/fast_food tag, and coordinates — no address, phone, or verifiable amenity data. All amenity fields must therefore be null.
concerns: URL greek-island-pizza.com is an Indonesian-language WordPress spam/SEO site (content about Surabaya restaurants; categories include 'Slot Gacor' and 'Ibcbet Login') — it does not belong to this North Vancouver pizza restaurant. The URL discovery confidence of 'high' appears to be incorrect.
No address present in OSM record — physical location cannot be confirmed.
No phone number present in OSM record.
All amenity fields are null due to the inability to access or verify the actual business website.
